title: Clinicopathological factors and prognostic analysis of adenoid cystic carcinomas of sublingual gland: a single-centre retrospective study of 41 patients
html: A retrospective review was performed to evaluate the clinicopathological factors and prognosis of patients with sublingual gland adenoid cystic carcinomas (ACC) from January 2007 to December 2023. Forty-one patients were included, 26 women and 15 men (median age 57 years; range 25–76). Surgical excision was performed in all patients, and the occult node metastasis rate was 12.5%. The median overall survival time was 117 months (range 13–147). Twenty-two patients developed recurrent disease after initial surgery.
